name: fieldmate
description: Phase-field / geometry-processing research copilot: cross-paper comparison, gap mining, corpus audits, preregistered experiment verification. Deterministic core (fieldmate CLI) + harness-side judgment.

description_i18n.en: Phase-field / geometry-processing research copilot: cross-paper comparison, five-slot reading cards, gap mining with evidence grading, corpus audits, preregistered experiment verification. Ships as a skill + sub-agent; the deterministic core is the fieldmate CLI.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 相场/几何处理方向科研助手：文献横向对比、五槽阅读卡、精进点挖掘（带证据分级）、语料自检、实验预注册与结果三态核验。判定归脚本（fieldmate CLI），判断归宿主模型。
